test_title: PYST 18 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that correctly changes this sentence into passive voice:

"Parents and schools play a pivotal role in promoting a healthy lifestyle."

options.text: A pivotal role is played by parents and schools in promoting a healthy lifestyle.
Parents and schools are played by a pivotal role in promoting a healthy lifestyle.
A pivotal role was played by parents and schools in promoting a healthy lifestyle.
A pivotal role is play by parents and schools for promoting a healthy lifestyle.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To change a sentence from **Active to Passive Voice**, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The original sentence is in the **Simple Present Tense** ("play"). 
 
• The formula for Passive Voice in Simple Present is: **New Subject + am/is/are + Past Participle (V3) + by + New Object**. 
 
 
• **Active Subject:** Parents and schools
 
• **Active Verb:** play
 
• **Active Object:** A pivotal role
 
• **Passive Transformation:** "A pivotal role" (New Subject) + "is" (Auxiliary) + "played" (V3) + "by parents and schools" (New Object).
 
 
 
• Why other options are incorrect: 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The meaning is reversed, suggesting the parents are being played by the role.
 
• **Option 3:** This uses **"was,"** which changes the tense to Simple Past. The tense must remain consistent.
 
• **Option 4:** This uses **"play"** (V1) instead of the required Past Participle **"played"** (V3).
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Analytical Insight:** *In competitive exams, voice change questions often try to trick you by changing the tense. Always identify the tense of the main verb first; if the active is present, the passive must use "is/am/are."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pivotal:** Central and important to the situation.
 
• **Lifestyle diseases:** Diseases linked with the way people live (e.g., Type 2 diabetes, heart disease).
 
• **Nourishment:** The food or other substances necessary for growth and health.
 
• **Adolescents:** Young people in the process of developing from a child into an adult.
